about.intro: my name is **Fernando Cortes**, I'm {{age}} years old and I'm from the interior of Minas Gerais, Brazil. In 2003, I moved to São Paulo to study Electrical Engineering at Mackenzie Presbyterian University, where I graduated in 2008.
about.education: I hold a postgraduate degree in Software Systems Architecture from FIAP and specializations in Clinical Engineering from Albert Einstein Institute of Higher Education and an MBA in Project Management from FGV-SP.
about.telecoms: For nearly a decade, I worked in the telecommunications sector, gaining extensive experience in managing decentralized teams, coordinating projects, and building relationships with internal and external clients.
about.career: In 2022, I decided to redirect my career to software development, where I found my true passion. Since then, I've worked as a developer at companies such as Ewally (fintech), Albert Einstein Israeli Hospital, and currently at XP Bank.
about.skills: I have hands-on experience with Node.js, .NET, React.js, AWS, Azure, Dynatrace, DataDog, Git, as well as SQL and NoSQL databases and caching solutions. I'm an enthusiast of software engineering best practices, applying principles such as SOLID, DRY, KISS, CQRS, and Clean Code in all my projects.
about.goal: My goal is to continue evolving as a software engineer, combining a solid technical foundation, collaborative mindset, and systemic vision to contribute to high-performance teams and products.

woodworking.title: Woodworking
woodworking.intro: My maternal grandfather was incredibly skilled. I remember him fixing drawers and creating toys like little cars and dollhouses. The smell of wood and his tool cabinet are still vivid in my memory.
woodworking.mentor: Another mentor was Taboca, my father's carpenter friend. Together, they created some of the coolest toys of my childhood.
woodworking.projects: In the photos below, some pieces I've built: a bench for the entrance hall made from reclaimed wood from door frames during the apartment renovation; a key and bag holder also for the entrance; and a desk over 2 meters long where my wife and I work facing each other.
woodworking.keyholder: Key and bag holder in the apartment hall

photography.title: Photography
photography.intro: You only live once, right? I love traveling and discovering new places, people, and cultures. But memories fade over time.
photography.passion: I started photographing encouraged by a coworker to participate in photography contests. What was a hobby became a passion. Today I photograph to preserve memories of the incredible places I've visited.
photography.macaw2: Pair of Red Macaws - Belem - PA
photography.macawFact: Did you know that macaws form lifelong pairs? When one dies, the other remains solitary until the end.

diy.title: DIY and 3D Printing
diy.intro: Many people ask me why I love engineering so much. The answer is simple: it taught me that I can build anything.
diy.passion: My mind is always buzzing with ideas. I'm constantly inventing something — for home or just for fun. I'm passionate about creating. I've made tables, knives, lamps, 3D sculptures, and art from scrap. I also enjoy programming bots and creating filters for photos and videos. Crazy stuff indeed!

demolay.name: DeMolay Order
demolay.description: The DeMolay Order is a youth group supported by Freemasonry since 1919, created in the United States with the goal of forming good citizens who respect laws and contribute positively to society. I've been part of it since I was 13 and there I had the opportunity to organize and actively participate in food and clothing donation campaigns, charity dinners, and distribution of basic food baskets to families in vulnerable situations.

vivo.name: Telefonica VIVO Foundation
vivo.description: The Telefônica VIVO Foundation has education as a pillar of social transformation, contributing to the development and digital inclusion of students and educators. The "Volunteers Day" is a global project that brings together employees from all Telefonica Group companies to renovate educational institution facilities, while another team promotes leisure activities with beneficiaries. I actively participated in this project between 2008 and 2010, contributing to renovations and interaction with young people.

minhacena.name: Minha Cena
minhacena.description: MinhaCena.Org is a social and educational impact platform that encourages improvement in writing and reading through the production of personalized illustrations for essays by students from public schools, private schools, and NGOs. I worked as a volunteer on the back-end development team, helping to create the online platform that connects students and volunteer illustrators to transform texts into art.
